title: Training and Agentic Inference Strategies for LLM-based Manim Animation Generation
abstract: arXiv:2604.18364v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generating programmatic animation using libraries such as Manim presents unique challenges for Large Language Models (LLMs), requiring spatial reasoning, temporal sequencing, and familiarity with domain-specific APIs that are underrepresented in general pre-training data. A systematic study of how training and inference strategies interact in this setting is lacking in current research. This study introduces ManimTrainer, a training pipeline that combines Supervised Fine-tuning (SFT) with Reinforcement Learning (RL) based Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) using a unified reward signal that fuses code and visual assessment signals, and ManimAgent, an inference pipeline featuring Renderer-in-the-loop (RITL) and API documentation-augmented RITL (RITL-DOC) strategies. Using these techniques, this study presents the first unified training and inference study for text-to-code-to-video transformation with Manim. It evaluates 17 open

translated_title: 基于大语言模型的Manim动画生成的训练与智能体推理策略
translated_abstract: 使用Manim等库生成程序化动画对大语言模型（LLM）提出了独特的挑战，这需要空间推理、时序排序能力，以及对在通用预训练数据中代表性不足的领域特定API的熟悉度。目前的研究缺乏对训练与推理策略在此类场景下如何相互作用的系统性研究。本研究提出了ManimTrainer，一个将监督微调（SFT）与基于强化学习（RL）的组相对策略优化（GRPO）相结合的训练管线，其采用融合了代码与视觉评估信号的统一奖励信号；同时提出了ManimAgent，一个具有渲染器在环（RITL）和API文档增强RITL（RITL-DOC）策略的推理管线。利用这些技术，本研究首次对基于Manim的文本到代码再到视频的转换进行了统一的训练与推理研究。本研究评估了17个开源……（原文摘要在此处截断，内容不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出了结合SFT与GRPO强化学习的ManimTrainer训练管线（采用融合代码与视觉信号的统一奖励），以及具备渲染器在环和文档增强策略的ManimAgent推理管线，首次对基于Manim的文本到代码到视频动画生成开展了统一的训练与推理系统性研究。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ManimTrainer, a training pipeline combining SFT with GRPO-based RL using a unified code-and-visual reward signal, and ManimAgent, an inference pipeline featuring Renderer-in-the-loop and documentation-augmented RITL strategies, presenting the first unified training and inference study for text-to-code-to-video Manim animation generation.
